# ArkhamPad

> ArkhamPad is the launchpad and trading site for Elysium, Kinetiq's Layer 2 for the Hyperliquid ecosystem. Browse every token on Elysium in one place, buy and sell any of them with HYPE, and launch your own coin in about 30 seconds with liquidity locked forever and 30% of trading fees paid to the creator. Log in with email, Google or a wallet; pay with HYPE or USDC.

## Key pages
- [Discover](https://arkhampad.com/): every token on Elysium with market cap, volume, holders and live trades
- [Create a coin](https://arkhampad.com/create/): launch a coin on Elysium; 1B supply, all in a locked pool, 60 HYPE start market cap
- [Bridge](https://arkhampad.com/bridge/): add HYPE from HyperEVM through the official Elysium bridge, or USDC from Base
- [Learn](https://arkhampad.com/learn/): guides to Elysium, trading and creating coins

## Facts
- Network: Elysium mainnet (chain ID 99901), an Arbitrum Orbit chain by Kinetiq that settles to HyperEVM; gas paid in HYPE
- Trading: any HYPE-paired Elysium token from one page; pay HYPE, receive tokens (or the reverse)
- New coins: 1,000,000,000 supply, all in the pool, no team allocation; 1% pool fee; 30% of fees to the creator; liquidity locked forever
- Deposits through the official bridge arrive in about a minute; withdrawals to HyperEVM take about 5.5 days (optimistic rollup challenge period)
- X: https://x.com/Arkhampad

- [Elysium vs HyperEVM: What's the Difference?](https://arkhampad.com/learn/elysium-vs-hyperevm/): Elysium vs HyperEVM compared: block space, speed, security model, gas, chain IDs and bridging. Learn when to use each chain in the Hyperliquid ecosystem.
- [HYPE on Elysium: Gas, Trading and Bridging Explained](https://arkhampad.com/learn/hype-on-elysium/): HYPE on Elysium explained: how it is bridged 1:1 from HyperEVM, why it pays gas, how tokens trade against it, and how to move it back. A plain guide.
- [Elysium Mainnet Launch: What Traders Should Know](https://arkhampad.com/learn/elysium-mainnet-launch/): Elysium mainnet launch guide for traders: the November 9, 2026 date, chain ID 99901, what is live at launch, what comes later, and how to prepare safely.
- [Elysium Gas Fees: What a Trade Really Costs](https://arkhampad.com/learn/elysium-gas-fees/): Elysium gas fees are paid in HYPE and are very low. See what a trade really costs: network fee, pool fee, router fee, price impact and slippage explained.

## Deposits and withdrawals
- [How to Bridge HYPE to Elysium from HyperEVM](https://arkhampad.com/learn/bridge-hype-to-elysium/): Bridge HYPE to Elysium from HyperEVM step by step: what you need first, how the official bridge works, how long deposits take and how much HYPE to keep for gas.
- [How to Buy Elysium Tokens with USDC from Base](https://arkhampad.com/learn/buy-elysium-tokens-with-usdc/): Buy Elysium tokens with USDC from Base on ArkhamPad. USDC is converted to HYPE on the way in, so you arrive ready to trade. Steps, costs and risks explained.
- [Elysium Withdrawal Time: Why the Bridge Takes 5.5 Days](https://arkhampad.com/learn/elysium-withdrawal-time/): Elysium withdrawal time explained: why the official bridge takes about 5.5 days to HyperEVM, what the challenge period protects, and how to plan your exits.
- [Trade Crypto with Email Login: Elysium Coins Made Simple](https://arkhampad.com/learn/trade-crypto-with-email-login/): Trade crypto with email login on ArkhamPad: sign in with email or Google, get an embedded wallet with no seed phrase, fund it with HYPE or USDC and trade.
